## What changed?

Describe the change in plain language.

## Why?

Explain the problem, opportunity, or decision this addresses.

## Impact

What products, patterns, users, or collaborators could this affect?

## Validation

Describe what was reviewed or tested.

## Deferred / unknown

List anything intentionally left for later or still unknown. Blank is acceptable when there is nothing to add.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and unrelated changes are excluded
- [ ] Documentation and implementation agree
- [ ] Mobile/field use was considered when relevant
- [ ] Accessibility was considered when relevant
- [ ] No credentials, secrets, private customer data, or sensitive fishing-location data are included
- [ ] Material assumptions are documented
- [ ] Meaningful shared-system decisions are ready for human review
